nih_chestxray14.name: NIH ChestX-ray14
nih_chestxray14.institution: National Institutes of Health Clinical Center (Bethesda, MD, USA)
nih_chestxray14.clinical_environment: Specialized clinical research hospital (oncology, rare diseases, ambulatory & inpatient)
nih_chestxray14.labeling_method: Automated NLP report mining (NegBio + CheXpert labeler)
nih_chestxray14.label_reliability: Moderate (~90% rule-based report accuracy, susceptible to mention-without-presence)

stanford_chexpert.name: Stanford CheXpert
stanford_chexpert.institution: Stanford University Medical Center (Palo Alto, CA, USA)
stanford_chexpert.clinical_environment: High-acuity tertiary academic medical center (ICU, Emergency Department, Inpatient)
stanford_chexpert.labeling_method: 3 board-certified radiologists consensus on validation set; NLP uncertainty labels on full cohort
stanford_chexpert.label_reliability: Very High on consensus validation cohort; explicit uncertainty (-1) on full cohort
domain_shift_factors: High proportion of AP portable supine/semi-erect ICU radiographs
Magnification of cardiothoracic ratio (CTR) on AP portable beam geometry
Severe fluid overload and pulmonary multi-morbidity in ICU patients
Foreign body artifacts (endotracheal tubes, central venous catheters, pacemakers, chest drains)

vindr_cxr.name: VinDr-CXR
vindr_cxr.institution: Hospital 108 and Hanoi Medical University Hospital (Hanoi, Vietnam)
vindr_cxr.clinical_environment: Major regional tertiary referral and teaching hospitals in Southeast Asia
vindr_cxr.labeling_method: 17 board-certified radiologists annotating local bounding boxes; 3-reader consensus decisions
vindr_cxr.label_reliability: Gold Standard (Verified 3-reader agreement on 14 thoracic findings)
domain_shift_factors: Southeast Asian demographic distribution (lower average BMI, smaller thoracic cage)
Endemic pulmonary conditions (post-tuberculosis scarring, bronchiectasis, apical fibrosis)
Native DICOM 16-bit dynamic range requiring specific VOI LUT windowing

mimic_cxr.name: MIMIC-CXR
mimic_cxr.institution: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (Boston, MA, USA)
mimic_cxr.clinical_environment: Large urban academic hospital ICU and Emergency Department
compliance_requirements: Completion of CITI Data or Specimens Only Research human subjects training
Signed PhysioNet Data Use Agreement (DUA) prohibiting re-distribution or de-anonymization
Access restricted to authenticated researchers; cannot be embedded directly in open repository
mimic_cxr.taxonomic_compatibility: Fully compatible (Uses identical 14-disease CheXpert NLP labeler)
